description: This file defines utility functions for making authenticated GET requests within a React frontend application. It includes functions for URL manipulation, adds authorization headers, appends organization identifiers, and handles response parsing and error handling. The main exported function is apiGet, a wrapper for fetch configured for specific API needs.

methods.name: isAbsoluteUrl(url)
methods.description: Checks if a URL is absolute (starts with http:// or https://).

methods.name: joinUrl(base, path)
methods.description: Concatenates base URL and path, ensuring proper slash handling.

methods.name: apiGet(url, options = {})
methods.description: Performs an authenticated GET request, injecting Authorization headers, appending organization_id as a query parameter if needed, and parsing the response.
